The scenario: a police auxiliary (协警) named 虞1某, originally from South Suburb Park police station, during a vehicle check with other police and auxiliary, they seized drugs from a drug dealer Liu. He then surrenders, confesses, returns one bag (25.26g). Let's recall Chinese criminal law: Article 351 (maybe 351) is about "帮助毒品犯罪分子隐匿、毁灭、伪造、变造毒品犯罪证据" (helping drug criminals hide, destroy, forge, alter drug crime evidence). The crime is "帮助毒品犯罪分子隐匿、毁灭、伪造、变造毒品犯罪证据罪". Also there is "容留他人吸毒" but not here. So the appropriate charge: "帮助毒品犯罪分子隐匿、毁灭、伪造、变造毒品犯罪证据罪". In examples, they used "容留他人吸毒" for similar. Check if any other crimes: He also may be charged with "受贿"? No. He is a state employee, but he didn't accept money. So just that.

Thus final answer.
